description.value: Days Inn by Wyndham Victoria Airport Sidney is a chain hotel on Beacon Avenue in Sidney, BC, positioned near Victoria International Airport and the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal. Its location makes it a logical overnight stop for touring cyclists starting or ending a trip via ferry or floatplane. The property is part of the Wyndham Rewards network and operates as a standard mid-range roadside hotel.
